recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future requests for direct CarePlan/EpisodeOfCare linkage should be handled as new Patient Care work-group decisions that revisit FHIR-19511 and FHIR-54402, not as unfinished application of FHIR-6131.
issue_request: FHIR-6131 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Patient Care request to let CarePlan reference EpisodeOfCare. Its accepted resolution added a 0..1 context element typed Reference(Encounter|EpisodeOfCare) with a usage note about activities occurring in other encounters or episodes.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite SVN #6766, which maps in git history to d6c4981fa8fe7d58cc3e1cc393aa8cc0b6a83c54. That commit added the historical CarePlan context row with Reference(Encounter|EpisodeOfCare) in source/careplan/careplan-spreadsheet.xml. A later CarePlan clarification commit, f39dde8e171836d3345715f788c746e0a1624492, still operated on that historical context element.
additional_context: FHIR-19511 is the later Published Patient Care workflow decision for CarePlan and related resources. It explicitly directed context to be renamed to encounter, changed to 0..1 Reference(Encounter), and stated that EpisodeOfCare linkage would be handled with a workflow extension. Commit 9e6a11d5a0bdd5e6489c0e130b394313dc9acb75 pre-applied that change. Current CarePlan is active in source/fhir.ini and has CarePlan.encounter Reference(Encounter) only. The FHIR Extension Pack defines workflow-episodeOfCare with CarePlan context and Reference(EpisodeOfCare). FHIR-54402 was resolved No Change in 2026 and reaffirmed that CarePlan-to-EpisodeOfCare linkage should use that extension instead of a direct core element.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Re-adding EpisodeOfCare to core CarePlan or adding a parallel core element would contradict later published decisions and current extension-pack coverage.

related_jiras.note: Later Published workflow decision changed CarePlan.context to CarePlan.encounter and moved EpisodeOfCare linkage to the workflow extension.
2026 Resolved - No Change ballot issue reaffirmed that CarePlan-to-EpisodeOfCare linkage is handled by workflow-episodeOfCare.
Question answered that the workflow-episodeOfCare extension is available from the separate extension repository across FHIR versions.
